title: Germany in the Eurovision Song Contest 1968
text: Germany has been represented at every Eurovision Song Contest since its inaugural edition in 1956, except in 1996 when its entry did not qualify past the audio-only pre-selection round, and consequently did not enter the final and does not count as one of its 69 appearances. No other country has been represented as many times.

title: German Emergency Acts
text: The German Emergency Acts were passed on 30 May 1968 at the time of the First Grand Coalition between the Social Democratic Party of Germany and the Christian Democratic Union of Germany. It was the 17th constitutional amendment to the Basic Law, adding emergency clauses to ensure the federal government's ability to act in crises such as natural disasters, uprisings or war.

title: July 2 - 18th Berlin International Film Festival
text: The 18th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from 21 June to 2 July 1968. The Golden Bear was awarded to Who Saw Him Die?

title: June 27-October 4 - 4. documenta
text: 4. documenta was the fourth edition of documenta, a quinquennial contemporary art exhibition.

title: Neue Nationalgalerie opened in Berlin.
text: The Neue Nationalgalerie at the Kulturforum is an art museum in Berlin, Germany. Its main focus is on modern art from the 20th century.
